usedFor: Eventzilla holds registrations and check-ins, and Brevo files attendees on lists through “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A registration is the moment someone becomes an attendee, and the action places them on a Brevo list.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo adds contacts that already exist, so a new registrant must be in Brevo first.
